The '''Caluula Resistance''' was a resistance movement operating on [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], hoping to rid the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the occupying [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sasso]] was a member who cooperated with [[Ferfer]] of the [[Ryn Network]] in hooking up with [[Team Meloque]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], who were on a [[Mission to Caluula|mission]] to destroy the world's [[yammosk]].
